$comment: Declared unreachable pointers in SYNCED content — skill markdown and the non-implementation assets the sync ships. See scripts/check-skill-consumer-refs.mjs. Three kinds: `doc` (a docs/ path outside the sync closure), `npm` (any npm run alias — the sync never merges npm scripts), `path` (a BARE upstream path in a tree the sync relocates; `node <path>` is excluded because the sync's rewriter maps exactly that form). Every entry needs a disposition and a real reason; a --update placeholder reason is rejected.

npm skills:check.reason: Lints skills/** authoring invariants, which exist only in the source repo.

npm skills:hydrate.reason: The worktree-hydration alias. Every site already says "if this repo defines no such script, add this entry" and inlines a bare node+git bootstrap, so the text works with or without it. The two in fleet/references/participant-rules.md (the chip participant block, 2026-10-08) point at that inlined entry in the same skill's SKILL.md preflight rather than repeating it.

npm skills:regenerate.reason: Regenerates .claude/skills/** from skills/**. Only the source repo owns skills/**; a consumer receives the generated half.

npm stores:drift.reason: Cross-store migration drift across every consumer — a source-repo operator command.

npm sync.reason: Run FROM the source repo to hydrate a consumer. Naming it inside consumer-facing text is telling the reader where to go, not what to run locally.

npm sync:dry.reason: Source-repo drift probe over every consumer. Meaningless in a consumer, which cannot see the other consumers.

npm upstream:queues.reason: Fans out over every consumer store; only the source repo has that registry.
